contentText:
Silver Pines. | Image: Wych Elm

You could say we're in the eye of the storm right now. The storm, of course, being the fall and winter release calendar for new video games. Things started out with a hectic few weeks that were packed with major titles like Control Resonant , Marvel's Wolverine , Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave , and Gears of War: E-Day . Meanwhile, next month will be dedicated almost entirely to two gigantic games: Nintendo's remake of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time and the long-anticipated Grand Theft Auto VI .
